mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_room_members(id, room_id, user_id, last_read_at) VALUES(#{id}, #{roomId}, #{userId}, #{lastReadAt})
mapper.select: SELECT m.user_id, u.username, u.display_name, u.avatar_url FROM chat_room_members m LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = m.user_id WHERE m.room_id = #{roomId} ORDER BY m.joined_at ASC
SELECT * FROM chat_room_members WHERE room_id = #{roomId} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE chat_room_members SET last_read_at = NOW() WHERE room_id = #{roomId} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM chat_room_members WHERE room_id = #{roomId} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT user_id FROM chat_room_members WHERE room_id = #{roomId}
